Usage: prime eval samples [OPTIONS] EVAL_ID

Positional arguments:
  EVAL_ID  [required]

Arguments:
  EVAL_ID  [required]

Options:
  -p, --page INTEGER  Page number  [default: 1]
  -n, --num INTEGER   Items per page  [default: 100]
  -o, --output TEXT   json|pretty  [default: json]
  --plain             Use plain, terse outputs. USE THIS IF YOU ARE AI.
  -h, --help          Show this message and exit.

  JSON output (--output json): .samples[] = sample object Common keys:
  .samples[].example_id?, .samples[].input?, .samples[].output?,
  .samples[].score? .total? = number .page? = number .limit? = number
